title: Settings
noteNetwork: Values come from build-time env. For local dev, use repo-root .env.
noteSecret: Service role keys are never embedded in CEP (CLAUDE.md).
groupGeneralDesc: Interface language. The panel reloads after you change this.
groupAppearanceDesc: Colors, shell, optional JSON, presets, and the component gallery (right column on wide layouts). In-dialog preview is live; other panels update when you save from the bottom bar.
workspaceBackdropHint: These two tokens drive the main panel chrome (`--bg-app` / surface behind widgets). Full token list and JSON follow below.
groupNetworkDesc: Read-only values from the build. Use repo-root .env for local development.
groupComponentsDesc: Static samples using the same CSS variables as the workspace (one row per control).
groupHostPathsDesc: Host folders resolved by CEP; unavailable outside the host.
themeActionsAria: Save theme, reset to defaults, undo, redo
shSettingsDialogMaxWidth: Modeless dialog max width (all shell dialogs)
previewNote: Same tokens as the workspace. Save from the footer to apply elsewhere.
closeConfirm: Theme changes are not saved. Close this window anyway? (Use Save & apply first to persist.)
resetOnboardingConfirm: Are you sure you want to reset onboarding?
localeSavedStatus: Language saved. Reload the panel to apply.
groupFeedbackDesc: Send a bug report or feature request to the ty-plus backend (Edge POST /reports). No service-role keys are used.
reportUnavailable: Report API is not available in this build.
reportValidation: Please fill in subject and description.
resetThemeConfirm: Reset all theme overrides to factory defaults? This cannot be undone from here (you can re-import JSON if exported).
themeJsonCopyFailed: Clipboard unavailable — JSON shown in the field below.
themeJsonInvalid: Invalid JSON — fix syntax and try again.
themeJsonHint: Only keys that exist in the design system are kept. Merge adds to the current draft; Save writes to storage.
galleryIntro: Static samples using the same CSS variables as the panel. Theme edits preview live in this dialog.
iconPresentationHint: Prefer Lucide for consistent alignment. Emoji is optional and dense across locales.
galleryNativeSelect: Native select (compact control; OS draws the list)
galleryListSelect: List select (large option rows — prefer for long menus)
galleryPresetListHint: Same layout as the workspace Presets dialog (ID / title / type / filePath).
galleryOnlinePresetGalleryHint: Same tile markup as the workspace Preset Library dialog (thumbnail + body + actions).
galleryButtonRowHint: Secondary actions: Outline or Default. Ghost always keeps a visible hairline border.
galleryCheckboxNote: Use checkbox for on/off (no separate switch).
